# Tool-name denylist for the exit audit: "deny <name>".
#
# The generated skill names tools by ROLE (file-read tool, file-write tool,
# file-edit tool, search tools, shell tool, URL-fetch tool, subagent tool,
# ask-user tool; defined in SKILL.md "## Host notes", Tool roles), never by a
# host's own tool name, so the skill runs on any agent host that offers those
# roles. Any backticked occurrence of a listed name, alone or in a
# "Name(args)" form, in a generated file fails the build.
#
# `grep` is deliberately absent: the rubric names it as a Unix command.
# Never name a `skill` tool either: no host-neutral form of it exists.

# Claude Code tool names
deny Read
deny Write
deny Edit
deny MultiEdit
deny Bash
deny Grep
deny Glob
deny Agent
deny Task
deny Skill
deny ToolSearch
deny WebFetch
deny WebSearch
deny AskUserQuestion
deny NotebookEdit
deny TodoWrite

# GitHub Copilot CLI tool names (the vocabulary of the pre-v11.4 output)
deny bash
deny powershell
deny view
deny create
deny edit
deny glob
deny web_fetch
deny task
deny ask_user
